userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-latex-viewer>` element presents editable LaTeX examples with rendered and generated HTML views.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Show code | Show or hide the editable LaTeX source. |
| Show output | Show or hide the output. |
| Example | Select a document from the loaded examples. |
| Rendered HTML | Display the rendered document. |
| Generated HTML | Display the generated HTML as read-only code. |
| Toggle editor toolbar | Show or hide the editor toolbar. |
| Reset | Restore the selected example's initial source. |
| Run | Render the current source. |
| Fullscreen / Exit fullscreen | Expand the entire component to fullscreen or return to its normal size. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between controls. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Activate a focused button. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open help for the component under the pointer, falling back to the focused component. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component from the hierarchy and open its help. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Esc</kbd> | Exit fullscreen. |
